brief: A KYC flow receives OCR text from an uploaded document and must decide whether it is an acceptable proof of address for the applicant. Accept only when the document is a utility bill, a bank statement, or a government letter, its issue or statement date is within the last 90 days of today, and the named account holder is the applicant (a first initial plus matching surname counts as a match). Reject otherwise. Today is 2026-09-24.
input_shape: { applicant_name: string, today: string (YYYY-MM-DD), ocr_text: string }
